title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 31. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to ensure that all measures taken to protect the EU against foreign interference and information manipulation include strong and resolute safeguards for fundamental rights, including freedom of expression; underlines that political differences should never be used as justification for censorship and that the EU should always be an area of free speech;
